status: Outside-source spectral control for texture/noise power and reference correlation

settings.window: Outside the fixed 2-sigma source mask, with a 3-pixel cosine taper to source/invalid boundaries and the outer Tukey window. Window-energy normalized. Usable if sum(w**2)>16 and effective area sum(w)**2/sum(w**2)>=64. An empirical background proxy, not an unbiased noise PSD; contains faint sources and mask coupling.
